resources.string: Recoverable KernelSU fixes and carefully controlled debloat profiles for Galaxy S23 devices
Independent, recoverable fixes for Recent Apps, Quick Search Back/APK results, Circle to Search and optional package controls.
Nothing is disabled by installing this update. Core fixes and Debloat Profiles are separate, and the app never deletes APKs or app data.

Root gives an app full system access. EvoX Quick Fix supports KernelSU on Android 16 only. Launcher3 supplies Recents and Circle integration; Vector is needed only for the verified Quick Search fixes. The folder fix repairs Quick Search external-storage folder actions, including APK results, and never installs an APK silently. Debloat is optional: every package starts on Keep, and only packages you select are disabled for user 0. Read Help before changing anything and keep ADB/Recovery available.

KernelSU grants controlled root access. Magic Mount-rs lets a small module add a missing system feature without editing /system. Launcher3 provides Quickstep/Recents. Quick Search is your HOME app. Vector loads two exact-build hooks only inside Quick Search: Back Guard and a router that repairs external-storage containing-folder actions, including the “Unable to open Download” APK-result case, through the system Files app. It never installs an APK silently. Google provides Circle to Search. Debloat Profiles only disable selected packages for user 0 and keep an ownership ledger for exact rollback.

Fully tested: SM-S918B on Android 16, user 0, KernelSU. Experimental: SM-S911* and SM-S916*. S23 FE, Magisk, work profiles and secondary users are not supported. Transparency and the Quick Search hooks stay locked to the verified SM-S918B environment and Quick Search 4.1.1 (78) APK hash.

Root and package disabling can break boot, calls, emergency alerts or apps. Start with one optional package. The app never runs Disable All, never uses pm uninstall and never clears data. Keep a real backup and ADB/Recovery access.
No analytics, no INTERNET permission, no automatic links and no terminal. All checks and ledgers stay on the device.
